title: Receipt
description: A receipt for a single compute job posted to a decentralised GPU market.

job_id.description: Job public key on the venue's chain.

market.description: Market public key the job was posted to.

host.description: Node's on-chain public key. Null until claimed.

gpu_class.description: GPU class reported by the venue. Null until known.

posted_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the job was posted.

claimed_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when a node claimed the job.

settled_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the job reached a terminal state.

result_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the job output artifact.

cost_nos.description: NOS token cost as reported by the protocol (job.price from @nosana/sdk). Units are venue-specific (NOS lamports in Nosana mainnet v0.4).
